headline: Senate sets cloture vote Monday on AGOA trade extension as both chambers gear up for August recess showdown!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed several commemorative resolutions including National Whistleblower Appreciation Day and Gold Star Children's Day. They also confirmed numerous military nominations across all service branches and began consideration of the AGOA Extension Act, with a cloture vote scheduled for Monday evening.
